_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your own keys. config.local.json is gitignored - never commit real keys.

tikhub.label: TikHub (社媒)
tikhub.notes: MCP exposes 23 tools (user info + demos + hybrid_video_data). The full data surface is the REST API (api.tikhub.io) with the same key. Cloudflare blocks non-browser User-Agent (error 1010) - always send a browser UA.

sellersprite.label: 卖家精灵 SellerSprite (电商)
sellersprite.notes: 45 tools. Key sits in the query string. Strong on Amazon: market_research, keyword_research, aba_research_weekly/monthly, google_trend, product_research, asin_prediction.

sorftime.label: Sorftime (电商+站外)
sorftime.notes: 105 tools. Multi-platform. reddit_post_search is a genuine social-voice source; tiktok_product_search covers TikTok Shop; ali1688_similar_product covers sourcing.

apify.label: Apify (降级 1)
apify.notes: Fallback scraper layer. Needs APIFY_TOKEN in env; if absent this tier is skipped and the chain falls through to tier 3.

web.label: WebFetch / WebSearch (降级 2)
web.notes: Grounded public-page search & fetch. Good for Google Trends snapshots, public keyword pages, news/blog signals. No auth, no structured schema - normalize results by hand into the stage CSV.

browser.label: 浏览器操作 (降级 3，最后手段)
browser.notes: browser-skill (bsk CLI) against the logged-in Chromium. Use only when tiers 1-3 are exhausted; slow and non-deterministic. Always record URL + capture timestamp in the stage provenance file.
